T: One mouse. Two brothers. Plenty of cheese.
D: Two brothers inherit a run-down mansion and a tiny mouse who refuses to leave.
P: Serve the snacks when the brothers set their first mouse trap with cheese.
S: the string cheese factory at the end
String cheese, aged cheddar, gouda and blue cheese on a board with crackers, grapes and a little bowl of nuts, enough to tempt any mouse.
the cheese they keep using as bait
Little toasties of cheddar and gruyère on buttered bread, grilled until golden and cut into wedge shapes with holes poked in the top.
Leftover spaghetti mixed with egg and parmesan, fried in spoonfuls until crisp, served with tomato sauce.
M: Ernie the chef and his fancy restaurant
Chicken breasts stuffed with spinach and ricotta, seared and roasted at 200C for 20 minutes, with a creamy mushroom sauce and potato gratin.
getting the mansion ready for auction
Pork loin rolled with sage and garlic, roasted at 200C with apples and potatoes, crackling and apple sauce.
W: the cheese the mouse is after
Baked vanilla cheesecake on a biscuit base, baked at 160C for 50 minutes, cooled in the oven, with lemon curd.
K: Cold milk shaken with honey and vanilla, poured into small glasses with a cheese biscuit on the side.

s.note: the string cheese factory at the end
s.how: Arrange string cheese, wedges of aged cheddar, gouda and blue cheese on a wooden board. Add water crackers, a bunch of green grapes and a little bowl of nuts. Leave one small wedge of cheese on its own at the edge of the board as bait.

s.note: the cheese they keep using as bait
s.how: Butter 8 slices of white bread on the outside. Fill with grated cheddar and gruyere and cook in a pan until golden and melting. Cut each into cheese-shaped wedges and poke a few holes in the top with a chopstick so they look like proper cartoon cheese.

m.note: Ernie the chef and his fancy restaurant
m.how: Cut a pocket in 4 chicken breasts and fill with wilted spinach mixed with ricotta. Sear, then roast at 200C for 20 minutes. Cook sliced mushrooms in butter, add 200ml cream and simmer until thick. Serve with potato gratin baked in more cream.

w.note: the cheese the mouse is after
w.how: Crush 250g sweet biscuits with 100g melted butter and press into a tin. Beat 500g cream cheese with 150g sugar, then beat in 3 eggs. Pour over and bake at 160C for 50 minutes, then cool in the oven. Spread with lemon curd before serving.

d.how: Pour 1L cold milk into a jar with 2 tbsp honey and a drop of vanilla. Put the lid on and shake hard until frothy. Pour into small glasses and set a little cheese biscuit beside each one, just in case anyone small comes looking.
